## Description

**What**: Update project documentation to reflect the new scratch CLI surface and the migration of the 5 sub-agent handoff sites.

**Why**: The new commands and the receipt-only return contract change how skill authors write handoff code; reference docs must reflect the new surface so future work uses the right path.

**Scope**:
- IN: Update `plugins/dso/docs/ticket-cli-reference.md` to document `scratch set|get|clear` and `--include-scratch`; update `plugins/dso/docs/SUB-AGENT-BOUNDARIES.md` or relevant skill-handoff doc to describe the receipt-only return contract and RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR semantics; add a `KNOWN-ISSUES.md` note if migration timing implications exist.
- OUT: Editing CLAUDE.md directly (route via `dso:doc-writer` only as a `CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE` report; do NOT edit CLAUDE.md directly).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `plugins/dso/docs/ticket-cli-reference.md` documents the `scratch set|get|clear` commands and the `--include-scratch` flag on `ticket show`, including the JSON envelope shape on hit and miss
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- When this story is complete, the sub-agent handoff documentation describes the receipt-only return contract and the RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR escalation semantics
  ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When this story is complete, the `DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION` block is present in the completion report, and any `CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE` reports have been surfaced to the user

## Considerations

- [Routing] Apply `plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/doc-router.md` gates before writing — default targets are SKILL.md / reference docs, not CLAUDE.md.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: Update project docs to reflect scratch CLI and sub-agent handoff migration
